Strong-baseline members (Bangladesh, capitalised Measured, bare N) cross threshold even on first or unsupported mentions, while weaker-baseline members (subjects, outcome, array, worldwide) need those boosts to cross threshold and ordinary frequent nouns, verbs and function words never do, so single-token swaps shift peak strength only modestly.
